title: Famous Places in the World
text:
The Eiffel Tower is in Paris. It is very tall and made of iron. Many people visit it every year. You can see the whole city from the top.

The Great Wall is in China. It is very long. Long ago, people built it to protect the country. Many tourists walk on it today.

questions.text: What did people build the Great Wall to protect?
Why do many people probably like to visit the Eiffel Tower?
options: Because they can see the city from the top
Because it is made of wood

questions.text: What can we guess about the Great Wall today?
options: It is an important place for tourists

vocabulary.definition: to go to see a place
to keep someone or something safe from harm

paragraph_translations: A Torre Eiffel fica em Paris. Ela é muito alta e feita de ferro. Muitas pessoas a visitam todos os anos. Você pode ver a cidade inteira do topo.
A Grande Muralha fica na China. Ela é muito longa. Há muito tempo, as pessoas a construíram para proteger o país. Muitos turistas andam nela hoje.
